description: Send a KakaoTalk message to the connected account itself (나에게 보내기) — arrives in the '나와의 채팅' room. Text or a feed card with a link. 연결된 카카오 계정의 나와의 채팅방으로 메시지를 보냅니다. Use to notify the owner (reports, alerts, approval links) without any app install. Needs text; optional title/url.

link.description: Where the message/button opens. mobile_web_url defaults to web_url.

confirm_token.description: Leave empty on the first call: the tool then only returns a preview and a token. Show the preview to the user, and only after they agree call again with exactly the same arguments plus this token. 처음엔 비워 두세요. 미리보기를 사용자에게 보여주고 동의를 받은 뒤, 같은 인자에 이 토큰을 넣어 다시 호출합니다.

text.description: Message body (≤200 chars). Becomes the description when title/imageUrl is given.

title.description: Optional — switches to a feed card with this title

url.description: Link the message/button opens. Must be a domain registered on the app's 플랫폼 > Web 설정.

name: kakao_send_to_me
